We need to determine number of carbonyl groups in the sample's compound. We need the sample's compound; not given directly. We may need to retrieve spectra to infer functional groups. Carbonyl groups show characteristic IR around 1700 cm-1, also carbonyl carbon chemical shift in 13C NMR ~190-220 ppm. Could use carbon NMR spectra tool to get peaks. Also could use IR spectra.

We need to know the sample's compound; maybe the environment has a sample loaded. Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool (no args) to get data. Then count carbonyl peaks. Let's call function.
